# make: make --no-print-directory -n sweep
# laug: laug sweep
# lease: absent
# compare: refused
[ "file" != file ] || { echo "laug · make sweep RUN_ID=<id>: name the run whose task queue to count" >&2; exit 2; }
addr=""; from=""; end=""; \
for f in faults/results/20261022-120000.json load/results/20261022-120000.json; do \
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue; \
  case "$f" in \
    faults/*) addr=$(jq -r '.address // empty' "$f"); end=$(jq -r '.after_end // empty' "$f") ;; \
    *) addr=$(jq -r '.cell // empty' "$f"); end=$(jq -r '.end // empty' "$f"); [ -z "$end" ] || end=$(date -u -d "$end" +%s) ;; \
  esac; \
  [ -z "$addr" ] || from="recorded in $f"; \
  break; \
done; \
 \
[ -n "$addr" ] || { addr='127.0.0.1:7233'; from="the default CELL_ADDRESS: the run recorded no address"; }; \
cutoff=''; \
[ -n "$cutoff" ] || cutoff=$(date -u -d "@$(( ${end:-$(date +%s)} - ${SWEEP_MARGIN_S:-30} ))" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); \
echo "laug · sweep omes-20261022-120000 on $addr ($from), workflows started before $cutoff" >&2; \
NAMESPACE=default load/sweep.sh "$addr" omes-20261022-120000 "$cutoff"
